content: Wankuyeim mo akin koukwed kweitan ikaliyow walba̱lab. Aygan towen wanmugwana aligen mamagina bwa̱gig aygan, mo ilivan; ilana, “Kumwen kum, bakatimlakeim aveiyag igaw mo bikamat.”

Nuwanaw Yowbad Kululuwan ikaweig inaweig, mo akin teitan nakabsis walba̱lab, waseg issin ikalleiwag. Towen wanakabsis ankakin mamagina dakul ikavvikawn. Dakul tasiyas yiges yasip o kaniliyan. Wuleil bo itoun nakabsis, magin ma̱wana dakul bwanabwein, yagan emela̱lid, singay ankakin bwein.
Nakabsis watoulan isiwnis kabsis babaw, sinawey kweivas. Tamumwey sinawey teivas isinis waskabsis tasiyas, asikweim pwapwa̱kaw; wakunus asipay goul tonen.
Kavikawn son pala̱pal meinoy neim nakabsis waseg. Nakabsis wamatan wodam kweinim kweiy nigidaged; Yowbad Kululuwan kweinim kweiy tasiyas.
Nakabsis wamatan ankakin mamagina yol taligubok tagon biniwal avakaein. Ankakin bo ma̱wan. Kadiykusan nakabsis walasin, mwana̱vas man. Mites ma̱wana bwa̱loug mites, singay babaw.
Mwana̱tan mamagina layon, mwanyuwein mamagina bulumakaw, mwantounun ivag magin ma̱wana gamag, mwanvasin mamagina bunibwan iyoyow.
Mansiyas mwana̱vas man pinpineis kweinim katanok, mites singay babaw wakulivis o pinpineis waskawan. Nag iyeiwas yam o boug waseg, illivans-wan; ilansa,

content.text: Kweiboug nises; nagein nises; igaw bises bisigeg.”

content: Mansiyas man ikavasis o iyakawanes o ikalin nuwes Towen wanakabsis. Ga-ikavasis mtowen mwamovan bises bisigeg, tamumwey tasiyas sinawey teivas ga-ikululs wamatan, biyakawanes towen mwamovan bises bisigeg. Ilaves asipay ineis wamatan nakabsis, ilansa;
“MaGuyaw Yowbad yak, kadiloka bakakavasim o bakayakawaneim. Mutawtoun avakaein waseg nukubun youd babaw, peinan nanoum waseg nukuvag bo babaw-wan tasiyasa nisesus.”
